**Result: compliant (preferred position).**

No restriction on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build appears anywhere in the Agreement, so nothing is redlined under NONCOMPETE. The "Field of Use" concept is a scope limit on our licence to Licensor's Platform (Spot FX market data and order transmission), not a restraint on our own competing activity — and the licence is expressly non-exclusive both ways. The three-year employee non-solicit and the change-of-control consent/ROFR are recorded for the non-solicitation and assignment rules respectively, so they are not double-flagged here. The only point I would raise commercially, not as a deviation, is that the Field of Use is confined to Spot FX; broadening it to other FX products would need Licensor's agreement.
